_comment: FEAT-405 (resolves FINDING-004, mitigates RISK-002) -- committed baseline for tests/unit/regression/test_frozen_files_checksum.gd. Every value below was captured from the ACTUAL working tree at the time this feature was implemented (post-US-010/FEAT-399, post-US-012 wiring) using the SAME SHA-256-of-file-text (String.sha256_text() on FileAccess.get_as_text()) convention already established by tests/tools/test_protected_files_unchanged.gd's PINNED_* constants -- this file simply externalizes that convention into a committed JSON fixture instead of GDScript constants, so future frozen-contract baselines can be regenerated/reviewed as a plain data diff. A mismatch against any value here means the corresponding frozen file/region/signature drifted from its recorded, reviewed baseline -- see NFR-003 (frozen-contract constraint) and RISK-002/FINDING-004 (previously only a manual git-log spot-check).

frozen_files_sha256._comment: Whole-file SHA-256 of the three NFR-003 frozen contract files. core/combat/reaction_window.gd (the path several existing round_session.gd doc comments use, e.g. its US-010 _execute_ai_plan() doc: 'core/combat/reaction_window.gd is never touched by this move') is this project's established doc-comment alias for the file that actually lives at core/application/reaction_window.gd -- the same file tests/tools/test_protected_files_unchanged.gd already pins byte-for-byte (PINNED_REACTION_WINDOW_SHA256), confirmed identical to the hash recorded below.

combine_action_controller_execute_signat._comment: core/controllers/combine_action_controller.gd -- the exact source line declaring CombineActionController.execute(), extracted via plain text-line parsing (not a real AST). Param names/types/order/return type must match verbatim.

round_session_strike_dispatch_region._comment: The Strike-dispatch/reaction-window/two-phase-commit region of core/application/round_session.gd's _execute_ai_plan() moved there verbatim by US-010/FEAT-399 -- the SAME PreHitAvoidance/OnHitMitigation reaction windows, genuine two-phase commit (to-hit roll -> await OnHitMitigation -> apply_on_hit_defense), budget-delta gate, rich-log recording, and Dodge-Step prompt call-outs that file's own _execute_ai_plan() doc and US-010 test_criteria describe as cut-pasted byte-for-byte from the pre-FEAT-399 advance_ai_turn() body. Delimited by two markers that are each verified unique in the file: start_marker is the match-statement's "Strike": case label (3-tab indent) inside _execute_ai_plan(); end_marker is the immediately-following "Combine": case label (3-tab indent) in the SAME match statement -- so the extracted region is everything from the Strike case through (not including) the Combine case, i.e. content.substr(content.find(start_marker), content.find(end_marker) - content.find(start_marker)).
